title: Gooddays holdings, Inc. announces an Equity Buyback for 114,000 shares, representing 1.51% for ¥64.3 million.
Gooddays holdings, Inc.'s Equity Buyback announced on November 26, 2026 has closed with 114,000 shares, representing 1.51% for ¥64.3 million.
